tests.checks: s1 see: a phone with workouts opens on the tabs and the Profile's own 'Workouts: N', not the error screen
(data only) s1 not: a phone with a profile goes straight into the app, never the welcome; completing setup clears the demo flag
s1 see: after an erase the welcome shows 'Get stronger every week', and again after a restart; s1 not: no 'Your N workouts are still here' line and no Profile
(data only) s1 see: the title and the 'Log every set at the gym...' line are the approved words (never checked on screen)
(data only) s1 not: no profile means the welcome, not an error

(data only) s1 see: a full phone gives the 'Your phone's storage is full. Free some space, then tap Try again.' body; s1 not: a failed upgrade lands on the error state, never the app; s2 see: Try again re-runs the upgrade and reaches ready; s2 not: a failed open is not remembered. Never the title, the buttons on this screen, the welcome hidden on screen, two start-ups at once, or the workouts kept
(data only) s1 see/not: the demo flag is carried through start-up; s2 see: erase returns to the welcome; demo flag re-read after a restore
s2 see: after Erase everything the welcome shows, no Profile and no workouts line. Never the demo badge on screen at start-up

(data only) s2 see/not: with a first-run time only newer workouts are sent by default; older ones only with 'Send older workouts too'. Never that the time is written once, kept on a later launch, or never sent to MettleUp or the gym
(data only) s1 see/not: a phone with a profile goes straight into the app, not the welcome. Never as a pass member, the gym look at start-up, or the gym link kept
(data only) s1 see: a read failure's body ends 'Your workouts are still on this phone. Tap Try again.' (the 'couldn't read' start is not checked)
(data only) s1 not: a failed read is the error state, never the welcome
s1 see/not: 'MettleUp could not start' on screen with no welcome, but for a database that would not OPEN, not a failed read; never a pass member or the gym link
s1 see: once the database is back, Try again opens the app on the Profile with the same 'Workouts: N' as before
s1 not: Try again while still broken really retries and shows the error screen again
s1 not: a failed open is not remembered; the next start tries again and Try again reopens (opens = 2)
s1 see: after the share sheet the line 'Keep this file somewhere safe. If you need help, send it to your gym...' shows
s1 not: tapping Save my data file opens Android's share sheet (the member picks where), checked by the script
s1 not: the file is only handed to the share sheet, once; nothing shared when there is no file
(data only) s2 see: start-up reads whether a profile exists. Never a parallel start opening a second handle, the first-open time kept, or screens waiting for start-up

(data only) s1 see: a failed upgrade step is the error state with stage 'upgrade', its body ends 'Your workouts are still on this phone. Tap Try again.' and differs from the open one; s1 not: never the app over a half-upgraded database; the old handle is closed before reopening. The title and the exact 'couldn't finish updating' words are never checked
s1 see/not: after a failed open the next start opens the database fresh and the failure is not handed back. Never the first-open time kept
s1 see: step 2 asks 'Kilograms or pounds?' (no app closed between steps)

(data only) s2 not / s3 see: the kept answers turn back into the same step, units and name; nothing kept on an untouched step 1. Never the app really closed and reopened, the start view not shown, another person's answers, 'Setting up…' or the answers cleared after the profile is made
s2 see: the line 'Your Hevy workouts and routines come in right after you tap Start training.' shows on step 1, and the Hevy import opens after Start training, but with no restart in between
(data only) s1 not: answers come back exactly from the kept text
(data only) s1 see / s1 not: a broken, empty or foreign mark gives nothing (start clean, no throw); an unknown goal, level or unit is dropped, never guessed

(data only) s1: a failed save stays on the welcome; s2 see: a later save enters the app. Never the 'Could not save your details' line, the kept answers surviving the failure, or being cleared after success
